title: Rust short-addr DAD: switch from CRC32 to FNV-1a32
description: Check rust/lichen-link/ or equivalent for short-address derivation. If using CRC32, update to FNV-1a32 (basis 0x811c9dc5). Validate against test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json.
close_reason: Obsolete: CRC32 is intentional for short-addr DAD per project-LICHEN-bo37; short_addr.rs uses crc32_ieee. FNV-1a is for TDMA/channel only.
